subject.title: fix: approval prompt misleading text for one-shot commands

question: Should this branch be repaired as the canonical fix for the redirected-command Allow Always wording bug, or should maintainers promote another overlapping PR?
rationale: Multiple open contributor PRs target the same root cause, and this branch still has a production-plumbing gap plus the external contributor proof gate.

options.title: Repair this branch first
options.body: Keep this PR open only if the author wires the reason through real exec request paths, syncs i18n, adds focused tests, and posts real prompt proof.

options.title: Promote a sibling PR
options.body: Use a better-proven overlapping branch as canonical, then close this branch only after that replacement is selected or merged.

options.title: Pause duplicate branches
options.body: Hold this cluster until an approval-area owner chooses the final implementation shape.

recommendation.title: Repair this branch first
recommendation.body: Keep this PR open only if the author wires the reason through real exec request paths, syncs i18n, adds focused tests, and posts real prompt proof.
